en: A sepia-toned panoramic view of a riverside town with mostly low wooden houses and a few larger masonry buildings. A wide, unpaved main street runs from the foreground up a hill into the distance. On the right stands a prominent Orthodox church with two domed bell towers. A tall flagpole rises in the left foreground. The overall style and print treatment suggest an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. Red printed captions in Russian and French/Latin script appear at the top and bottom.
